articles.headline: Bam Adebayo's triple-double ignites Heat's 123-113 victory over Thunder
articles.description: In a game that did not feature Oklahoma City's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander or Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo swiped the spotlight, scoring 24 points en route to a triple-double, as the surging Heat defeated the Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win
articles.description: — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.

articles.headline: Mikal Bridges shakes off slump, hits buzzer-beater to save Knicks vs. Blazers
articles.description: Mired in a shooting slump, Mikal Bridges delivered a buzzer-beating 3-pointer to lift the Knicks past the Trail Blazers after they squandered a 26-point lead.

images.name: Mikal Bridges [600x400]
images.caption: Mikal Bridges, who is averaging career lows in points and field goal percentage this season, nailed the game-winning 3 at the buzzer for the Knicks on Saturday night.
